**JOB SUMMARY**

This position serves as a primary customer point of contact for the installation and training of Pharmacy Management, Point of Sale, and TelePharm Systems. You will work closely with the implementation, hardware, and project management teams to successfully onboard and train pharmacy clients. Key responsibilities include traveling on-site to implement software and hardware, and to train new or converted PMS, POS, and/or TelePharm customers during their onboarding. It is essential to represent the organization professionally, maintain patience, demonstrate a positive attitude, and possess strong skills in training and communicating with end users.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conduct remote and on-site system installation and deliver software and hardware training to customers
* Lead pre-installation calls with customers to review processes, set expectations, and address customer questions
* Gather and verify all required information prior to go-live, coordinating pre-installation conference calls and communicating with the Project Manager as needed
* Perform basic computer setup, configuration, and networking
* Troubleshoot issues to determine whether networks, workstations, or peripheral hardware are responding correctly to the program’s instructions
* Serve as a responsive point of contact for Outcomes customers during the implementation process
* Multi-task, prioritize, and manage multiple projects efficiently
* Ensure all required documentation is completed and submitted on time throughout the implementation process
* Prepare and submit accurate expense reports promptly
* Assist in documenting and maintaining SOPs at the manager’s discretion
* Participate in occasional internal project work as assigned by the manager
* Perform additional tasks as needed based on specific installation or training requirements

**COMPLEXITY OF TASKS**

* Complexity of tasks: Medium - works on problems of moderate scope which are often varied and routine

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Regular business hours, Monday – Friday. Workweek is typically 40+ hours and may extend to 12+ hours on certain days depending on workload and project scope. Flexible hours may include evenings and some weekends. Weekends duties may include travel on Saturdays and travel plus installation on Sundays
* Travel Requirements: Domestic and/or international, up to 100% of the time

**KNOWLEDGE & REQUIREMENTS**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both customers and team members
* Ability to remain positive, calm, and professional under pressure or in stressful situations
* Strong, approachable presence with a willingness to assist others
* Demonstrated strong work ethic and self motivation
* Proven problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze situations, think critically, and develop effective solutions
* Ability to visualize complex issues think abstractly identify resolutions
* Team-oriented mindset with a collaborative approach
* Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum of 2 years of customer service experience, preferably in the healthcare field
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

The physical demands described below are representative of those an employee must meet to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

* Frequent sitting in stationary position at a desk
* Occasional standing, walking, stooping, kneeling, squatting, and climbing stairs
* Occasional twisting or turning of the body
* Occasional reaching by extending hands and arms in any direction
* Occasional lifting, pulling, or pushing of objects up to 40 lbs

**What’s In It For You?**

* Medical, Dental and Vision Plans
* Voluntary Benefits
* HSA & FSA
* Fertility & Family Planning Benefits
* Paid Parental Leave
* Adoption Assistance Program
* Employee Resource Groups
* Flex PTO for Exempt Associates & up to 15 PTO days in first year of employment for non-exempt associates
* 11 Paid Holidays
* Corporate Wellness Program
* 401k Employer Match & Roth Option Available – immediate eligibility

jobs.description:
Security Implementation Engineer
================================

**Location:** Remote (United States)  
**Reporting to:** Director of Cybersecurity  
  
At **STN**, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting-edge solutions, and a security-first mindset. We provide end-to-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future-ready transformation.  
  
As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long-term impact.  
  
Our approach is innovation-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.  
  
**Overview**  
We are seeking a hands-on Security Implementation Engineer to design, deploy, integrate, and operationalize security controls for STN One customers and internal environments. This is an ownership role: you will translate requirements into working deployments, validate telemetry and enforcement, resolve difficult integration issues, and hand solutions over with the documentation and controls required to operate them safely.  

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

**Security Solution Implementation & Deployment**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of SIEM, endpoint protection, and segmentation solutions, from discovery and architecture through production rollout, validation, and handoff.
* Configure and integrate platforms such as Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSIAM/XDR, SentinelOne, and Illumio, including management policies, sensors/agents, connectors, and API-based integrations.
* Onboard and normalize relevant log sources (identity, endpoint, firewall, cloud, server, network); verify coverage, parsing, timestamps, data quality, and alert routing.
* Design deployment patterns for Windows, Linux, and hybrid/cloud workloads while accounting for connectivity, access permissions, change windows, scalability, and rollback.

**Security Platform Integration & Operational Readiness**

* Integrate Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, GlobalProtect, Cloudflare security services, Okta/Microsoft Entra ID, and infrastructure monitoring sources as required by approved solution designs.
* Partner with the security operations team to verify telemetry delivery to XSIAM, detection rules, case routing, segmentation policies, and post-deployment monitoring readiness.
* Collaborate with customer infrastructure, IAM, networking, and SOC teams to establish effective policies, telemetry, detections, and operational ownership.

**Technical Troubleshooting & Security Controls**

* Troubleshoot complex agent health, data collection, authentication, networking, and performance issues without compromising production availability.
* Apply secure configuration, least-privilege access, secrets management, and tenant isolation to each customer implementation.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Produce implementation plans, architecture diagrams, test evidence, runbooks, administrator guidance, and acceptance criteria; conduct knowledge transfer.
* Improve reusable deployment standards, automation, templates, and quality gates across customers and internal STN initiatives.

Experience & Qualifications
---------------------------

**Required**

* 5+ years of hands-on cybersecurity engineering, systems integration, or security-platform implementation experience, including ownership of production deployments.
* Practical implementation experience with at least two of the following: enterprise SIEM/XDR, EDR, SOAR, or micro segmentation; ability to go deep on at least one platform.
* Strong Windows/Linux administration, networking (DNS, routing, TLS, proxies, firewalls), IAM, and API troubleshooting skills.
* Experience designing log onboarding, parsing/normalization, endpoint rollouts, or segmentation policy validation in customer environments.
* Ability to lead technical discovery, write clear implementation documentation, manage deployment risk, and communicate directly with customer stakeholders.
* At least one current security-platform certification relevant to the role, such as a Palo Alto Networks Cortex or network-security certification, Microsoft SC-200, or a comparable vendor-recognized SIEM/EDR/segmentation credential.

**Preferred**

* Direct implementation experience with Cortex XSIAM, SentinelOne, and/or Illumio in managed, multi-tenant environments.
* Python or PowerShell scripting; infrastructure-as-code, API automation, and configuration testing.
* Experience with Azure/AWS data sources, distributed networks, deployment change controls, and SOC operational readiness.

Compensation
------------

* Full-Time, Exempt
* $135,000-$160,000/year, DOE

Benefits
--------

* Health Coverage – Medical, Dental & Vision
* FSA Health and Dependent Care available
* 401(k) Plan
* Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Observed Holidays Paid
* Cell Phone Allowance
* Collaborative, growth-driven culture

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US. STN is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

**About Us:**

We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better.

ChiroHD (https://www.chirohd.com/) is the cloud-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication - everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product-market fit - prepped, proven, and ready for scale!

**Role Overview:**

As an Onboarding Specialist, you're the first person our new customers work with after they sign, and you set the tone for their entire experience with us. You'll lead live kickoff and training calls, provide guidance and support as customers work through their own account setup, and help ensure they feel confident and prepared to use the product by the time they go live.

Our onboarding process is primarily self-guided, meaning customers are responsible for completing their own setup, while you serve as a trusted resource to answer questions, provide direction, and help them navigate the process successfully.

This is a customer-focused, hands-on role on a growing onboarding team. Your work directly impacts how quickly customers become successful with our product and their long-term satisfaction and retention.

**What You'll Do**

* **Lead Live Training.** Run kickoff and training calls that introduce new customers to the onboarding process, explain setup expectations, and demonstrate how to use the product in their day-to-day operations.
* **Support Customers Through Go-Live.** Serve as a resource throughout the customer-led onboarding process, providing guidance, answering questions, setting clear expectations, and helping customers stay on track toward a successful launch.
* **Assist with Launch Readiness.** Provide guidance on account configuration and complete light configuration tasks when needed to support a successful go-live, while ensuring customers remain responsible for their own account setup.
* **Follow Up Proactively.** Reach out to customers who are stalled or struggling, offer assistance when needed, and flag early signs of risk to your manager.
* **Improve the Process.** Keep onboarding records accurate and current, and share customer feedback and recurring friction points with the team so we can continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Who You Are:**

* **Experienced**. You have 1–3 years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or a similar customer-facing role.
* **Effective Communicator**. You're a confident, friendly communicator who can lead a live training call and make a non-technical person feel capable.
* **Customer-Focused**. You care about customers' outcomes, not just finishing the checklist. You want them to be using the product and getting value from it.
* **Organized and Dependable**. You can manage a full caseload of clinics at different stages without losing track of next steps or commitments.
* **Quick Learner**. You pick up new software quickly and can explain it simply, even when you're still learning it.
* **Self-Directed**. You're comfortable working remotely, taking feedback, and sharing what you learn with the team.

**Preferred Experience (Nice-to-Have):**

* Hands-on experience in a medical practice or with EHR software (ChiroHD preferred)
* Experience using Customer Success tools like Gainsight or ChurnZero
* History of supporting small business customers directly
* Proven ability to document, refine, and improve workflows
* Skillful at using AI tools to boost efficiency and productivity

**Non-Negotiables (Disqualifiers):**

* Lacks prior experience in SaaS onboarding or software implementation
* Lacks customer-facing experience conducting live training or kickoff calls
* Unable to work standard working hours in Central or Eastern Time

**Why ChiroHD?**

**Impact & Growth:**

* Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market.
* PE-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively.
* Established product-market fit; scaling outbound-led growth engine now.
* High-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth.
* Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility.

**Culture & Values:**

* Customer-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do
* Low-ego, builder-first environment where the best ideas win
* High-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results
* Commitment to work-life balance and professional development

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible PTO and remote-first culture

**UC OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT**  
  
At the University of California (UC), your contributions make a difference. A world leader producing Nobel and Pulitzer Prize recipients with over 150 years of groundbreaking research transforming the world. Choose a career where you can leverage your knowledge, skills and aspirations to inspire and support some of the greatest minds in the world, and those who will follow in their footsteps. Working at the University of California is being part of a unique institution, and a vibrant and diverse community. At the University of California, Office of the President, we propel our mission through impactful work locally, in government centers and systemwide. We are passionate people, serving the greater good.  
  
The University of California, one of the largest and most acclaimed institutions of higher learning in the world, is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and public service. The University of California Office of the President is the headquarters to the 10 campuses, six academic medical centers and three national laboratories and enrolls premier students from California, the nation and the world. Learn more about the UC Office of the President  
  
**Department Overview**  
  
Systemwide Labor Relations (SWLR) is responsible for negotiating and administering 20 systemwide labor agreements and 14 local agreements with 16 unions covering over 180,000 academic and staff employees across the UC system. This includes bargaining on first contracts, successor contracts, accretion, impacts and effects bargaining, side letters, mid-term modifications and the sunshine process. Administering the systemwide and local collective bargaining agreements also involves creating systemwide guidance around contract implementation and contract interpretation, handling formal requests for information, authoring and issuing critical union communications, and providing training, advice, and counsel to local labor relations staff across the system. In addition, Systemwide Labor Relations plays a critical role in labor disputes, including grievance processing, unfair labor practice charges, and strike preparation and responses. SWLR collaborates closely with key partners within UCOP including UC Legal (UCL) on labor-related litigation activity, the Office of State Governmental Relations (SGR) in representing the University's position on legislative, budgetary and policy matters concerning labor relations and collective bargaining, and the External Relations & Communications team to respond to media inquiries and develop messaging on labor relations and collective bargaining matters for internal and external stakeholders. This includes bargaining on first contracts, successor contracts, accretion, impacts and effects bargaining, mid-term modifications and the sunshine process. Administering the systemwide and local collective bargaining agreements also involves contract interpretation, contract implementation, grievance processing, handling formal requests for information, collaboration and coordination with Systemwide Human Resources departments, union communication, and providing training, advice and counsel to local labor relations staff across the system. Other key components that fall within the scope of SWLR include monitoring and ensuring compliance with bargaining agreements and legislation regarding contracting out services. SWLR collaborates closely with key partners within UCOP Including the UC Legal on labor-related litigation activity, the Office of State Governmental Relations (SGR) in representing the University's position on legislative, budgetary and policy matters concerning labor relations and collective bargaining, and the Strategic Communications and Media Relations team to respond to media inquiries and develop messaging on labor relations and collective Bargaining matters for internal and external stakeholders. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement within the state of California. The selected candidate must reside within the state of California or be willing to relocate.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Reporting to the Associate Director of Labor Operations, the Contract Implementation Manager applies labor relations, payroll, compensation, and systems expertise to support the implementation of wage, compensation, and benefits provisions contained in systemwide collective bargaining agreements. This role coordinates with labor relations professionals, compensation and payroll teams, UCPath, Benefits, Retirement, UC Legal, and other systemwide and location-based stakeholders to promote accurate, timely, and consistent implementation of contractual requirements. The Contract Implementation Manager develops implementation strategies, provides recommendations, monitors represented employee data and reporting requirements, and helps resolve complex issues involving labor relations systems, data, and processes. The role serves as a resource to labor relations, compensation, payroll, and other operational professionals; supports systemwide meetings related to contract implementation; supports data collection and reporting related to contract administration and union Requests for Information as needed; and identifies opportunities to improve processes affecting the represented employee population. The manager is expected to work independently with limited direction, exercise sound judgment, and address significant issues requiring labor relations expertise, political sensitivity, and coordination across multiple stakeholders. The role requires strong oral and written communication skills, knowledge of labor relations terminology and contractual requirements, and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse internal and external contacts. The manager may lead process improvement initiatives and provide guidance to professional staff while operating within the direction and priorities established by the Associate Director of Labor Operations.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
40% Contract Implementation and Systems Coordination: Coordinate the implementation of wage, compensation, benefits, and other applicable provisions of systemwide collective bargaining agreements in collaboration with Labor Relations Managers, Chief Negotiators, compensation and payroll professionals, UCPath, Benefits, Retirement, and other relevant stakeholders. Apply knowledge of contract language, payroll processes, data systems, and represented employee populations to support accurate and timely implementation across UC locations. Maintain implementation plans, logs, decision logs, and institutional records. Track implementation activities, identify outstanding issues, and coordinate follow-up to ensure contractual requirements and established timelines are met. Support systemwide meetings related to contract implementation and promote consistent practices across locations and bargaining units.  
  
20% Contract Implementation Analysis and Recommendations: Analyze collective bargaining agreement language, implementation requirements, payroll and compensation processes, and represented employee data to identify potential issues and develop recommendations. Consult with labor relations colleagues, subject matter experts, UC Legal, Systemwide Compensation, UCPath, Payroll, Benefits, Retirement, and location representatives as needed to understand operational impacts and develop effective approaches. Provide subject-matter expertise during bargaining, settlement discussions, side-letter negotiations, and other labor relations processes to assess implementation feasibility, identify operational and systems impacts, inform proposals, and help develop language that can be implemented accurately and consistently. Identify implementation issues that may require additional review, escalation, or a systemwide response. Apply independent judgment and labor relations knowledge to address complex or sensitive matters while advancing the University's contractual and operational objectives.  
  
20% Data Management and Reporting: Coordinate and undertake the collection, review, organization, and reporting of represented employee data related to collective bargaining agreements, contract implementation and the represented employee population. Provide operational coordination and support for data collection efforts in response to formal Requests for Information from unions as needed. Work with appropriate UCOP offices and locations to clarify data needs, confirm data accuracy, maintain appropriate records, and support timely responses, including pulling, manipulating, and delivering large data sets based on stated (and sometimes unstated) needs, in addition to coordination and oversight. Identify data management or reporting concerns and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.  
  
10% Process Improvement and Systems Management: Identify and support the development and implementation of process improvements, protocols, and tools related to contract implementation, contract administration, payroll and compensation transactions, labor relations systems, data management, and reporting. Monitor implementation workflows and related records to promote completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. Strategically leverage available systems and tracking tools, maintain effective document management practices, and recommend improvements that increase efficiency and reduce implementation errors across the UC system.  
  
10% Coordination, Communication, and Operational Support: Serve as a resource to labor relations, compensation, payroll, and other professionals at UC locations and within the Office of the President. Coordinate actions among multiple offices, locations, and individuals to support contract implementation and resolve issues. Communicate implementation requirements, timelines, decisions, and outstanding issues clearly to relevant stakeholders. Identify matters requiring specialized review or additional direction and escalate them to the Associate Director of Labor Operations and other appropriate leaders. May provide guidance to professional staff and support supervision, coordination, or training activities as assigned.  
  
**Experience**  
**Required Qualifications**  
  
Minimum 8 years relevant experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience  
  
**Skills and Abilities**  
Required Qualifications  
  
Working knowledge of HRIS and related systems and applications used to manage human resources, payroll, compensation, benefits, or financial data.  
  
Familiarity with collective bargaining agreements and the ability to interpret and apply contract provisions related to wages, compensation, benefits, payroll, data, and reporting.  
  
Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex contract, systems, data, and implementation issues clearly to diverse audiences.  
  
Skill in coordinating projects, implementation activities, timelines, meetings, and follow-up actions involving multiple offices, locations, and stakeholders.  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex or sensitive issues, identify potential impacts, and develop practical recommendations.  
  
Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when addressing contract implementation and administration matters.  
  
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with labor relations professionals, Chief Negotiators, UCOP departments, UC locations, union representatives, and other internal and external stakeholders.  
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities and complete work accurately within demanding and time-sensitive contractual, operational, and implementation deadlines.  
  
Ability to identify process improvement opportunities and support the development and implementation of effective systems and contract administration practices.  
  
Ability to maintain accurate records and protect confidential, sensitive, and legally protected information.  
  
Ability to work independently with limited direction while appropriately seeking guidance, escalating issues, and keeping leadership and stakeholders informed.  
  
Ability to provide guidance, training, and operational support to professional staff and other individuals involved in contract implementation and related systems or data processes.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.description:
### **This is a remote role** **Position Details + Benefits**

* $85K base salary. We pay 100% of employee premiums for our base medical, dental, and vision plans

* Remote role. Travel up to four times per year to NYC or other ParentChild+ sites for training, professional development, and other program activities.

* 403(b) - 6% employer match! + FSA + HSA

* High accountability + high flexibility culture

### **About Us**

ParentChild+ is a national early childhood organization founded in 1965. We work with local partners across the country to help families support their children's early learning and prepare them for school. Our National Center provides training, resources, and support to the organizations delivering our programs in their communities.

We have two home visiting models:

* Family Model: Helps parents support their children's learning and development through play, books, and everyday interactions.

* Home-Based Child Care Model: Helps home-based child care providers create engaging learning environments for young children.

At each local site, Coordinators manage the program, train and supervise staff, and support program quality. Early Learning Specialists (ELSs) visit families or child care providers, using books, toys, and play to support children's learning and development.

### **Your Mission**

Your job is to coordinate and co-lead training opportunities for new ParentChild+ Family Model Coordinators and Home Visitors as they prepare to launch a new site. You'll also manage the process of helping new Family Model sites get started from initial planning through onboarding and training.

You'll work closely with our other National Center teams to make sure your training and onboarding run smoothly and that new sites have the support they need to succeed.

### **Responsibilities**

Facilitation, Coaching + Practice Support

* Lead two intensive, six-week training programs each year, along with smaller training sessions throughout the year. You'll train about 25 new Coordinators annually from partner organizations who are learning to bring the Family Model to their communities. Your manager and other trainers will help you prepare and lead these sessions.

* Work with your manager and other teams to prepare and lead training on assessments. You'll receive formal training to prepare you for these sessions, as needed.

* After training, you'll continue working with these Coordinators through a Community of Practice (CoP). You'll lead group meetings every two weeks for seven months, helping Coordinators solve problems, support their Home Visitors, and improve how they run their programs.

* Turn Family Model standards and findings from program evaluations into clear, practical guidance that Coordinators and sites can use in their daily work.

### **Program Management & Operations**

* Manage the New Coordinator Training Institute and Communities of Practice. Work with your manager to set training priorities, coordinate with other trainers, and make sure new Coordinators learn the skills and Family Model standards they need.

* Use program data, evaluation findings, participant feedback, and experience from local sites to identify training needs and improve future training.

* Build and improve administrative processes across departments for training, evaluation, and other activities involving local sites. Coordinate schedules, registration, communications, materials, and recordkeeping so responsibilities are clear and work runs smoothly.

* Maintain and update documents, training materials, and other resources shared with sites on the Staff Portal, working with other departments on updates and translations as needed.

* Develop and coordinate program eBlasts to share training opportunities, evaluation activities, program updates, and other important information with our network.

### **Site Startup + Onboarding**

* Develop and manage a clear, consistent process for helping new Family Model sites get started, working closely with other National Center teams.

* Coordinate the steps involved in opening a new site, including schedules, staff responsibilities, site orientation, and preparation for training. Make sure everyone understands what needs to happen and when.

* Track each new site's progress, identify problems or areas where additional support is needed, and work with State Directors and other teams to help sites get their programs up and running.

### **Qualifications**

* 5+ years' experience in early childhood or family support programs.

* Adult Learning + Facilitation: Experience developing and leading training for adults, including group discussions and activities. Experience with reflective supervision or coaching is a plus.

* Organization + Program Management: Strong organizational skills, including managing schedules, coordinating projects, and keeping multiple activities on track.

* Equitable Orientation: Commitment to strength-based, equity-centered, and culturally responsive practice.

* Technology: Comfortable using Microsoft Office, Zoom, and Management Information Systems (MIS).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* You speak Spanish or another ParentChild+ priority language (e.g., Mandarin, Arabic, or Haitian Creole).

* Basic understanding of data analysis

### **What Success Looks Like in Your First Year**

* New Site Onboarding: Create and document a clear process for starting new sites, including responsibilities, timelines, and what sites need to have in place before launching. Test and improve the process as new sites come on board.

* Program Operations: Improve administrative processes that support work across departments, including site communications, eBlasts, and maintaining Staff Portal resources. Make sure responsibilities and timelines are clear.

* Training Management: Plan and manage two annual training institutes and their Communities of Practice. Keep training organized, meet deadlines, and improve processes to reduce administrative work.

* Training Delivery: Lead engaging training sessions that encourage discussion, reflection, and practical learning. Demonstrate strong facilitation skills through observation and positive participant feedback.

* Coaching + Practice Support: Build coaching skills through training and practice. Gradually take on more responsibility for coaching Coordinators and sites, with support from your manager.

* Training Improvement: Use participant feedback and program data to identify training needs and make a meaningful improvement to foundational training.

**ABOUT METRC**

Metrc is the most trusted and experienced provider of cannabis regulatory systems in the United States and is growing extremely rapidly to expand globally. We provide a solution that combines advanced software, radio-frequency identification (RFID) technology, a dedicated customer-support team, and a secure database to track and trace cannabis from growth, harvest, and processing to testing, transport, and sale. As the Implementation Specialist, you will have the opportunity to thrive in a fast-moving, fluid environment, and be passionate about implementing change, great processes and procedures in a commercial setting at a fast-growing technology company.

As an Implementation Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in the success of Metrc’s Retail ID product offering and optimization of our cloud-based platform to align with our company's needs and the evolving expectations of our clients. This position requires a unique blend of technical proficiency, keen analytical skills, and a collaborative spirit to effectively engage with various internal teams and external partners.

* Guide clients through the onboarding process, including system setup, configuration, integration, and data migration as needed

jobs.description:
The Electronic Health Record (EHR) Specialist, will play a key role in optimizing EHR solutions that enable Aledade’s partner practices to improve patient outcomes, reduce healthcare costs, and increase efficiency.

The EHR Specialist will collaborate with practice stakeholders along with the multi-disciplinary Aledade team to identify, develop, and implement EHR solutions to support strategic ACO initiatives. Additionally, this role will facilitate the collection of practice-generated data that can be used for population-based analytics.

They will have depth of knowledge in at least one top-tier ambulatory EHR solution, have a strong understanding of practice workflow, and be able to travel periodically. The EHR Specialist must thrive in a fast-paced environment, respond well to change, and be a strong verbal and written communicator.

### **Primary Duties**

* Lead EHR Optimization efforts for assigned projects:

  + Coordinate efforts to conduct assessments of how practices are currently utilizing their EHR systems and identify areas where their systems can be optimized to support ACO initiatives.
  + Assist practices to fully leverage their existing EHR systems or other 3rd party systems to support strategic ACO initiatives.
  + Assist practices with implementing technology to provide point of care population health insights that work in conjunction with their EHR.
  + Support practices with MIPS compliance.

* Provide EHR expertise:

  + Identify common approaches, such as templates or customized reports that practices can use to achieve specific aims, such as Medicare Wellness Visits, Transitions of Care, Advance Care Planning, or Risk/Hierarchical Condition Categories.
  + Identify existing or develop new educational materials that can assist practice staff in understanding how best to utilize their EHR system.
  + Understand relevant EHR vendor system updates specifically related to population health management.
  + Develop and support EHR-system-specific user groups composed of representatives from Aledade’s ACO practices to identify best practices and training opportunities.
  + Provide strategic input on how EHR optimization can support ACO initiatives.

* Facilitate data exchange:

  + Assist practices in ensuring data is properly captured in their EHR systems in order to accurately generate quality measure and other reporting.
  + Ensure practices are able to share practice-generated data with Aledade.
  + Assist with development of integrations, interfaces, and data sharing strategies for assigned practices.

* Project Management:

  + Independently manage multiple projects at various stages to provide Aledade’s tools and train practice staff on patient-centric, value based workflows.
  + Communicate project progress effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
  + Present to audiences ranging from practice leadership/executives to front line staff, influencing adoption of best practices and materials that orient to Aledade’s service.
  + Proficiently deliver detailed but concise training content on complex material to multiple client stakeholders.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s degree is required. Significant and relevant work experience in lieu of educational requirements may be accepted.
* 4-6 years experience working as a client-facing project lead in the healthcare industry (i.e., ambulatory practice, EHR vendor, health plan, hospital, government, management consulting) with a proven track record of creating, maintaining, and enhancing customer relationships and optimization of their EHR systems.
* Must have previous implementation or optimization experience with top-tier ambulatory EHRs and practice management software, preferably with expertise in Epic Ambulatory, NextGen, Athena, Greenway, or eClinicalWorks products.

### **Preferred KSA’s**

* Relevant competencies include developing and maintaining relationships with all team members, organizational skills, project management, critical thinking, problem solving, attention to detail, and effective written and verbal communication.
* Must be self motivated and open to learn new EHR platforms/workflows.
* Must be results-oriented with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining focus on key goals.

### **Physical Requirements**

*Sitting* *for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.*

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles

Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)

Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays

401(k) with up to 4% match

Stock options

And much more!
